_doc: Stop hook config: when files under a listed folder changed (since the last passing commit, or uncommitted), every check for it runs before the agent may stop. Commands run in that folder; non-zero exit = fail; exit 3 = skipped (reported, never a pass).

game: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && T="$(git rev-parse --git-path claude-checks)/inline.js" && python3 -I -c "import re,sys;open(sys.argv[1],'w').write('\n'.join(re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',open('game/index.html').read(),re.S)))" "$T" && node --check "$T"
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && { [ -d node_modules/playwright ] || { echo 'browser replay (tools/bot.js) SKIPPED: run npm install at the repo root'; exit 3; }; node tools/bot.js; }
tools: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && T="$(git rev-parse --git-path claude-checks)/inline.js" && python3 -I -c "import re,sys;open(sys.argv[1],'w').write('\n'.join(re.findall(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',open('game/index.html').read(),re.S)))" "$T" && node --check "$T"
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && { [ -d node_modules/playwright ] || { echo 'browser replay (tools/bot.js) SKIPPED: run npm install at the repo root'; exit 3; }; node tools/bot.js; }
